+## Docket (the web app)
+
+Docket lives in `src/web`. It has two parts: the **trail explorer**, which reads the compiled build trail
+(`trace.json`: plans, nodes, rules, tests and verdicts) and shows how each rule was built, and the
+**workbench**, which calls this API (`/api/...`) so a policy can be sold, retrieved, cancelled, claimed on and
+renewed from a browser. It is React, TypeScript and Vite.
+
+**In Visual Studio:** open `Uinsure.Policies.slnx` and choose the **API and web** startup profile (it is in
+`Uinsure.Policies.slnx.slnLaunch`). F5 starts the API on port 5080 and the web dev server on
+`http://localhost:4170`, which proxies `/api` to the API. The web project is excluded from the solution build,
+so `dotnet build` never runs npm. Run `npm ci` in `src/web` once first.
+
+**From the command line:**
+
+```sh
+dotnet run --project src/Uinsure.Policies.Api --launch-profile http   # the API, port 5080
+cd src/web
+npm ci
+npm run trace      # compile trace.json from git history
+npm run build
+npm run preview    # http://localhost:4173, /api proxied to port 5080 (set DOCKET_API_PORT to change it)
+```

+
+## The Static Web App
+
+`modules/staticwebapp.bicep` creates `stapp-<suffix>` (Standard plan, because a linked backend is not on Free)
+and a `linkedBackends` child that links the App Service. The host then forwards `/api` to the API from the same
+origin, so the browser makes no cross-origin call and the page's Content-Security-Policy stays `default-src 'self'`.
+
+- **Host settings.** `infrastructure/web/staticwebapp.config.json` sets the deep-link fallback (routes rewrite to
+  `index.html`; assets, JSON files and `kitchen-sink.html` are excluded) and repeats the CSP as a header. The Web
+  stage copies it into the build artifact.
+- **No secret in the repo.** The deployment token is read from the resource at deploy time
+  (`az staticwebapp secrets list`), set as a masked pipeline variable and passed to the pinned Static Web Apps
+  CLI in an environment variable. It is in no parameter file or variable group.
+- **The web stage.** A `Web` stage runs after `Build` and before `dev`, on a hosted agent: `npm ci`, typecheck,
+  lint, CSS lint, unit tests, the trace compile (`npm run trace`, which reads git history, so the checkout is
+  full-depth), the build, and Playwright against the API started on the agent. It publishes a `web` artifact.
+  `Deploy_<env>` then deploys that artifact with the Static Web Apps CLI and smoke-tests the site's root.
+- **Configured, not tested.** None of this has run: the stage, the token step and the CLI deploy are
+  schema-checked and read by eye only. The self-hosted deploy agents need Node (for `npx`).
+- **Known mismatch, not fixed here.** A linked backend forwards `/api/...` to the App Service unchanged, but the
+  API's routes have no `/api` prefix (the dev server and preview proxy strip it). The API would need a path base of
+  `/api` for the deployed host to reach it. That is an API change, outside this node.

+param suffix string
+param tags object
+
+@description('Static Web Apps is not offered in every region, so this is its own parameter, not the workload region.')
+param location string
+
+@description('Resource id of the App Service that /api is linked to.')
+param backendResourceId string
+
+@description('Region of that App Service.')
+param backendRegion string
+
+// Standard, because a linked backend is not available on the Free plan.
+resource site 'Microsoft.Web/staticSites@2023-12-01' = {
+  name: 'stapp-${suffix}'
+  location: location
+  tags: tags
+  sku: {
+    name: 'Standard'
+    tier: 'Standard'
+  }
+  properties: {}
+}
+
+// Same-origin /api: the host forwards /api to the App Service, so the browser makes no cross-origin call and the
+// Content-Security-Policy stays default-src 'self'.
+resource backend 'Microsoft.Web/staticSites/linkedBackends@2023-12-01' = {
+  parent: site
+  name: 'api'
+  properties: {
+    backendResourceId: backendResourceId
+    region: backendRegion
+  }
+}
+
+output siteName string = site.name
+output hostName string = site.properties.defaultHostname
